pr_title: Fixes issue #11933:FastThreadLocal.set(V) method throws NegativeArraySizeException after called more than (1 << 30) times of new FastThreadLocal()
pr_body:
Motivation:

Fixes issue #11933: FastThreadLocal.set(V) method throws NegativeArraySizeException after called more than (1 << 30) times of new FastThreadLocal()

Modification:

Add index bound check in methods `io.netty.util.internal.InternalThreadLocalMap#expandIndexedVariableTableAndSet` and `io.netty.util.internal.InternalThreadLocalMap#nextVariableIndex`.
Result:

Fixes #11933.
pr_comments: @laosijikaichele can we have an unit test well ? Also I wonder if this is really an issue in real-wold
@normanmaurer OK, will add the unit test soon.
@chrisvest I guess it is ok for now and if we see any issues we can disable the test :)
